title: To the Fairness Frontier and Beyond: Identifying, Quantifying, and Optimizing the Fairness-Accuracy Pareto Frontier
benchmark_measurement: Not applicable. The paper's benchmarks did not measure any aspects of faith or religion; they focused on fairness related to age, gender, and race.
findings: There were no findings related to religion as it was not a subject of the paper's empirical analysis. The term 'religion' is mentioned once as an example of a protected attribute under the Federal Fair Housing Act, but it is not included in the study's experiments.
